name: AI Stealth Gateway
postCreateCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list || true && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y xvfb libgl1 libglx-mesa0 libosmesa6 libgbm-dev libnss3 libasound2 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libgtk-3-0
postStartCommand: npm install && npx --yes pm2 delete all || true && npx --yes pm2 start npm --name 'ai-gateway' -- run start
